mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may enhance gentamicin nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity through increased renal tubular damage and oxidative stress, while potentially inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated gentamicin metabolism.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and auditory function regularly; consider alternative antibiotics if turmeric supplementation is concurrent and high-dose gentamicin is required.
